title: OpenAI and the CSU system bring AI to 500,000 students & faculty
summary: The largest deployment of ChatGPT to date will expand the use of AI in education and help the United States build an AI-ready workforce.
body: The largest deployment of ChatGPT to date will expand the use of AI in education and help the United States build an AI-ready workforce.
summaryZh: OpenAI与加州州立大学（CSU）系统达成合作，将ChatGPT部署到面向50万学生和教职员工的教育场景中，成为迄今为止最大规模的教育AI部署之一。原始信息显示：The largest deployment of ChatGPT to date will expand the use of AI in education and help the United States build an AI-ready workforce.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“OpenAI and the CSU system bring AI to 500,000 students & faculty”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI与加州州立大学系统合作，将ChatGPT部署给50万师生。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
